path.description: Feature directory within the selected application source root.

project.description: Angular application project. Required when the workspace has multiple applications.

routePath.description: URL path for the lazy route. Defaults to the page name.

access.description: Route access mode. Protected routes require an already-configured reusable auth guard.

authGuard.description: Existing locally imported auth-guard identifier used by protected routes.

navigationLabel.description: Navigation label stored in route data. Defaults to the classified page name.

navigationIcon.description: Optional Material icon name stored in route navigation data.
